Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Does the Nosferatu Bestial's ability to employ retainers during untap count
as an instance of "playing cards from the hand in the normal fashion"? That
is, can it be canceled with Direct Intervention? I suppose it probably
can't, since Pier 13's effect is very similar and that can't be Direct
Interventioned.

thanks,

Josh

a beastly thing

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct, it does not.

Playing a retainer in the normal fashion involves tapping an acting minion
during the minion phase.
